employers.sectionLead: Write requirements in a structured way. Candidate skills and certificates are compared against them.
employers.sectionBody: Built for roles where licences, certificates and specific skills matter.

employers.d3Text: See the match and a short explanation. Start with people who meet the requirements.

seekers.title: For job seekers
seekers.description: One profile. More matching jobs. Kvalifits is free for job seekers.
seekers.heroSubtitle: Add skills and certificates once. See which jobs match, and apply quickly. The service is free for job seekers.
seekers.ctaHint: Creating an account is free. Profile, skills, certificates and applications live in one place.
seekers.sectionLead: Employer requirements and your skills are comparable. See why a job matches you.
seekers.sectionBody: Especially useful if you have licences, certificates or specialised experience.
seekers.d1Text: Experience, skills and preferences sit in one profile.
seekers.d2Text: Certificates are visible on your profile before the interview.
seekers.d3Text: See your match before you apply, then send the application in Kvalifits.
seekers.p1Desc: Employers see what you can do and what is verified.
seekers.p2Desc: Match and requirements use the same language. Choose jobs that actually fit.

seekers.tutorialTitle: Five quick steps before you sign up
seekers.tutorialStep1Body: Fill fields cleanly: skills, preferences, certificates if you have them — it’s your structured pitch to employers.
seekers.tutorialStep2Body: Your profile title, keywords, preferred place and work format directly affect fit for each job.
seekers.tutorialStep3Body: Structured fields: what you do, what’s evidenced, where you fit — not one long CV block.
seekers.tutorialStep4Body: Each application shows how well your profile matches that job’s requirements — before you go deep.
seekers.tutorialStep5Body: Finish your profile, browse roles, apply, and track application fit in one place.

jobs.applicantMatchExplainFitText: The headline number is a fixed weighted sum (35% skills & keywords + requirement-line evidence, 25% certificates / qualification phrases, 15% experience ladder, 10% role title vs job title, 10% location, 5% work format & employment type). It is deterministic — not AI. Bars show points earned out of each weight. Current score: {scoreLabel}.
jobs.applicantMatchExplainBreakdownText: Each bar is contribution points out of that component’s fixed weight (they sum to the headline percentage, up to rounding).
jobs.applicantMatchExplainBreakdownTextCalm: The score ranks and recommends fit between your job and the applicant snapshot — it does not auto-reject anyone or make the final hire decision. Below: supporting indicators, contributions by axis and structured evidence, then factors that made the result more conservative.
jobs.applicantMatchLegacyModel: This application was scored with an older model; bars are an approximate remap for display.
jobs.applicantMatchPenaltyHint: The model may lower the headline when data implies hard limits — that is not an auto-reject. The employer makes the final decision.
jobs.applicantMatchReducingFactorsHint: Model adjustments and caps keep the headline realistic — they are not a verdict on the candidate’s worth.
jobs.applicantMatchFinalScoreHint: For prioritisation: the base sums contributions; the headline includes model adjustments.
jobs.applicantMatchClampedToZero: After adjustments the computed score would have been below zero ({unclamped}p); the UI shows 0%.
jobs.applicantMatchSoftFloorNote: Because the profile still shows partial positive indicators (e.g. experience, location, or light professional overlap), the final score is kept visible. Before that adjustment it was {before}%; the visibility lift added +{added}%.
jobs.applicantMatchPositiveSignalsIntro: These points reflect post–profile overlap and earn base points even when the final headline is more conservative after adjustments.
jobs.applicantMatchReducingReasons: Context: why the result is below the base
jobs.applicantMatchReducingHint: This describes model logic, not a hiring recommendation — use it to guide conversation and follow-up checks.
jobs.applicantMatchPenaltyReasons: Context: why the result is below the base
jobs.applicantMatchPenalty_no_skill_requireme: Overlap in skills and requirement evidence is currently very limited.
jobs.applicantMatchPenalty_weak_skill_require: Overlap in skills and requirement evidence is modest.
jobs.applicantMatchPenalty_role_title_mismatc: Profile focus and title are less aligned with this job.
jobs.applicantMatchPenalty_missing_required_c: Required certificate/qualification evidence is missing or insufficient.
jobs.applicantMatchPenalty_missing_mandatory_: Evidence for mandatory requirements is weak or missing — this reduces the score strongly.
jobs.applicantMatchPenalty_partial_mandatory_: Mandatory requirements are only partially met.
jobs.applicantMatchPenalty_missing_recommende: Limited overlap on recommended requirements (smaller impact than mandatory).
jobs.applicantMatchPenalty_cap_missing_mandat: Score ceiling: without mandatory-requirement evidence the maximum stays lower.
jobs.applicantMatchPenalty_requirements_misma: There is limited evidence against key requirement lines.
jobs.applicantMatchPenalty_professional_align: Role and skills signals are both limited at the same time — worth clarifying in conversation.
jobs.applicantMatchPenalty_cap_no_skill_overl: Score ceiling: with very limited skills/requirements overlap, the headline stays low.
jobs.applicantMatchPenalty_cap_role_title_mis: Score ceiling: role/title mismatch keeps the maximum more conservative.
jobs.applicantMatchPenalty_cap_missing_requir: Score ceiling: missing required certificate/qualification evidence lowers the maximum.
jobs.applicantMatchPenalty_cap_professional_a: Score ceiling: if role + skills are both limited, the maximum stays lower (not automatically zero).
jobs.applicantMatchWeakAreas: Areas to clarify — confirm in conversation
jobs.applicantMatchAxisCheckpoints: Areas to clarify — confirm in conversation

jobs.applicantMatchWeak_certificates: Certificate/qualification phrase alignment is partial or unclear.
jobs.applicantMatchWeak_experience: Experience level is below what the post expects, or missing on one side.
jobs.applicantMatchWeak_location: Location indicators do not align strongly (on-site roles are stricter).
jobs.applicantMatchWeak_work_job_type: Work format or employment type fit is weak versus stated preferences.
jobs.applicantMatchWeak_requirements_mandator: Evidence for mandatory requirements is weak or missing.
jobs.applicantMatchWeak_languages: Language skills do not align with the job expectation.
jobs.applicantMatchWeak_work_mode: Work arrangement (remote/hybrid/on-site) does not align with preferences.
jobs.applicantMatchWeak_arrangement: Work arrangement or schedule fit is weak.
jobs.applicantMatchWeak_workload: Desired workload differs from what the job expects.
jobs.applicantMatchWeak_availability: Availability or start timing is a weak fit for this job.
jobs.applicantMatchNoSkills: No skills listed on the snapshot.
jobs.applicantMatchNoRequirementLines: No structured requirement lines on this post.
jobs.createSubtitle: Save a draft, choose a package, and test the flow. Payment will be connected later.
jobs.introBody: Fill in the fields. The job is saved as a draft until you publish. Payments are not taken yet.
jobs.jobFieldGuideIntro: Each section below has a short hint (how much and in what format). Required fields are marked; the form enforces minimums before publishing.
jobs.jobFieldGuideSummary: One short block (1–2 sentences). Minimum 20 characters. Shown in jobs and search.
jobs.jobFieldGuideDescription: Full role description: the team and working environment. Minimum 40 characters. Add duties and benefits separately below.
jobs.jobFieldGuideDuties: One duty per line. Optional. These lines are not used in matching.
jobs.jobFieldGuideBenefits: Optional. Add only if you want benefits shown separately. These lines are not used in matching.
jobs.jobFieldGuideRequirementsExtra: One requirement per row. Add at least two. Mark required or preferred. Be specific (licences, experience, language) — this is used to show match.
jobs.jobFieldGuideSkills: Single line, comma-separated. At least 1 tag (e.g. B licence, AutoCAD). These are the clear “must-have” role tags.
jobs.jobFieldGuideKeywords: Also comma-separated, at least 1 tag. Used for search and matching (e.g. industry, tool, method). May overlap skills, but can include broader search terms.
jobs.jobFieldGuideExperience: Pick the expected experience level. If “Previous work experience is not required” is selected, 0 years does not lower fit and the role suits first-job seekers.
jobs.jobExperienceNotRequiredHint: No minimum experience required. First-job seekers and 0 years of experience are not penalised for this.
jobs.jobDetailCreateProfileCta: Create a profile to see your match.
jobs.applyClosedBody: Applications are closed for this listing.
jobs.applicationDeadlineHint: Last day candidates can apply. Shown as “Apply until …”.
jobs.expiresOnHint: After this date the listing is marked inactive (not deleted).
jobs.errApplicationDeadlinePast: Application deadline cannot be in the past.
jobs.errDeadlineAfterExpiry: Application deadline cannot be after listing expiry.
jobs.jobLifecycleDatesFixHint: Could not save. Please try again.
jobs.jobReportHint: Choose a reason. The report goes to Kvalifits admins for review.
jobs.jobReportThanks: Thanks. Your report was saved and will be reviewed by an admin.
jobs.jobReportErrDetailsOther: Please add a short explanation for “Other”.
jobs.jobReportErrJob: Listing not found or no longer public.
jobs.jobReportErrGeneric: Could not submit the report. Please try again.
jobs.jobReportFixHint: Could not save. Please try again.
jobs.jobFieldGuideCert: Optional. Short phrases separated by commas or semicolons (e.g. “Forklift licence, valid B category”). If empty, certificate matching can still use the “Keywords for search…” field.
jobs.jobFieldGuideSalary: Required. Choose a fixed amount or a range; default is gross (bruto). Example: 2300–2700 € bruto / month.
jobs.jobSalaryRequiredHint: You cannot publish an active listing without salary information.
jobs.errSalaryModeRequired: Choose salary type: fixed amount or range.
jobs.errSalaryRangeOrder: Minimum salary must be less than or equal to maximum.
jobs.jobSalaryStructureFixHint: Could not save. Please try again.
jobs.jobFieldGuideApplication: Applications are only on Kvalifits — candidates submit through the platform.
jobs.jobFieldGuideEditLead: When editing, the same minimums and formats apply — see the hints under each field.

jobs.duplicateForbidden: Only the job owner can duplicate this listing.
jobs.draftSaved: Draft saved. It is not public yet.
jobs.draftHint: Saving does not publish the job. Use “Publish job” when it is ready.
jobs.previewBannerBody: Only you can see this view. Job seekers cannot see it or apply.
jobs.errCompanyRequired: Your company name must be on the company profile.
jobs.publishValidationNeeded: Complete the required fields to publish, then try again.
jobs.packageHint: Choose the listing duration (30 or 90 days). Prices are planned — payments are not open yet. On expiry the listing is marked inactive, not deleted.
jobs.employerProfileIncomplete: Your company profile is incomplete. Please complete it before creating a job.
jobs.employerProfileIncompleteBody: To create a job you need: company name, contact email, location, industry, and a company description (at least 40 characters).
jobs.summaryPlaceholder: 1–2 sentences with the key points of the role.
jobs.errJobLinesTooMany: You can add up to 30 lines.
jobs.errJobLineTooShort: Each line must be at least 2 characters.
jobs.errJobLineTooLong: Each line can be at most 200 characters.
jobs.applicationKvalifitsOnlyBody: Candidates apply only on this platform — external application links are not used.
jobs.jobRequirementLinesHint: e.g. B licence, 3+ years experience, Estonian
jobs.jobRequirementLinesHelp: Each requirement is stored separately for matching.
jobs.jobRequirementPriorityHelp: Mark each requirement as mandatory or recommended. Matching weights mandatory requirements more heavily.
jobs.jobRequirementsPriorityFixHint: Could not save. Please try again.
jobs.jobFieldGuideTaxonomySkills: Pick skills from the catalog. Filters and matching use stable IDs; the job description stays free text.
jobs.jobProfessionHint: The listing title can stay free text. Profession drives structured filters and matching.
jobs.jobLanguagesHint: Optional. Used in language filters and matching.
jobs.leftoverTaxonomyHint: Previous free-text that the catalog did not cover — kept until you remove it.
jobs.errProfessionRequired: Select a profession from the catalog.
jobs.jobCertRequirementsPlaceholder: Comma- or line-separated, e.g. valid B licence; forklift certificate
jobs.errRequirementLines: Add at least two requirements (one per line).
jobs.errRequiredSkills: Add at least one required skill (comma-separated).
jobs.errShortSummary: Short summary is too short (at least 20 characters).
jobs.errDescriptionLength: Job description is too short (at least 40 characters).
jobs.jobMatchingIncomplete: Some required fields for publishing are still incomplete. Check structured requirements, skills, and keywords.
jobs.csvHintJobs: comma-separated, e.g. B licence, AutoCAD, team leadership

jobs.workConditionsTitle: Working hours and nature of work
jobs.workConditionsHint: These fields help check working conditions for younger applicants. Job seekers do not see an exact age — only a short suitability summary.
jobs.includesNightWorkHint: Tick if the role involves night work or significant late-evening hours.
jobs.isHazardousWorkHint: Tick if the work is hazardous, heavy, or otherwise restricted for minors.
jobs.youngSeekerAutoHint: The “Also suitable for young job seekers” badge appears on the listing automatically when hours, day length, shifts, and nature of work pass the Kvalifits pre-check. It cannot be set manually.
jobs.youngSeekerAutoWillShow: Based on current conditions, the badge will show on the public listing.
jobs.youngSeekerAutoNeedSchedule: Add hours or shift times so the pre-check can evaluate the badge.
jobs.youngSeekerAutoNotYet: Current conditions do not pass the pre-check — the badge stays hidden until hours / shifts / nature of work may suit a young seeker.
jobs.youngSeekerAutoFixHint: Could not save. Please try again.
jobs.suitableForAges1617: This job may suit a 16–17-year-old candidate
jobs.suitableForAges1617Hint: If you select this, we check hours, day length, shift times, and nature of work against minor employment rules. Legal limits cannot be overridden — you must change the conditions.
jobs.suitableForAges1617ConflictTitle: Conditions appear to conflict with limits for ages 16–17
jobs.suitableForAges1617ConflictBody: Please review the work conditions. You cannot save this flag until the conflict is resolved.
jobs.suitableForAges1617NoOverride: Legal limits cannot be ignored or overridden. Adjust hours, shifts, or nature of work, or clear this flag.
jobs.suitableForAges1617Ok: Based on current conditions, this job may suit ages 16–17 (base limits). A specific candidate’s learning obligation may still need further review.
jobs.suitableForAges1617FixHint: Could not save. Please try again.

suitableForAges1617Issue.missing_schedule_data: Add at least weekly or daily hours, or both shift start and end — suitability cannot be confirmed without them.
suitableForAges1617Issue.daily_hours_exceeded: Daily hours exceed the limit for ages 16–17 (up to {maxDaily} hours).
suitableForAges1617Issue.weekly_hours_exceeded: Weekly hours exceed the limit for ages 16–17 (up to {maxWeekly} hours).
suitableForAges1617Issue.shift_outside_allowed_window: Shift times fall outside the allowed window for ages 16–17 ({earliest}–{latest}).
suitableForAges1617Issue.night_work_not_allowed: Night work / late evening shifts are not suitable for a 16–17-year-old candidate.
suitableForAges1617Issue.hazardous_work_restricted: Hazardous or restricted work is not suitable for a 16–17-year-old candidate.
suitableForAges1617Issue.generic: Work conditions do not meet the limits for ages 16–17.

jobs.minorEligibilityScheduleNotSuitable: This schedule does not fit age-related restrictions

minorEligibilityIssue.missing_schedule_data: The listing lacks enough schedule / shift data — suitability needs additional review.
minorEligibilityIssue.missing_learning_obligation: Your profile is missing learning-obligation status (ages 16–17). Add it for a complete work-condition check.
minorEligibilityIssue.daily_hours_exceeded: Daily hours exceed your age-band limit (up to {maxDaily} hours).
minorEligibilityIssue.weekly_hours_exceeded: Weekly hours exceed your age-band limit (up to {maxWeekly} hours).
minorEligibilityIssue.shift_outside_allowed_window: Shift times fall outside the allowed window ({earliest}–{latest}).
minorEligibilityIssue.night_work_not_allowed: Night work is not allowed for your age band.
minorEligibilityIssue.hazardous_work_restricted: Hazardous or restricted work is not suitable for your age band.
minorEligibilityIssue.full_time_with_learning_obligation: Full-time work with a learning obligation needs additional review.
minorEligibilityIssue.full_time_for_age_band: Full-time work may need additional review for your age band.

jobs.applyEligibilityCanStillApply: You can still apply. Match is used for ranking; the employer makes the decision.
jobs.applyEligibilityBlockedHint: This is about working-condition fit, not a low match percentage. You can still apply — the employer decides.

jobs.applyEligibilityIssue_legal_needs_review: Age-related work conditions need an extra check.

jobs.applyEligibilityIssue_workload_incompati: Your desired load and the job’s workload don’t align.

jobs.applyEligibilityIssue_hours_incompatible: Job hours don’t fit your current working-time preferences.
jobs.applyEligibilityIssue_schedule_does_not_: You marked that the schedule does not fit.
jobs.applyEligibilityIssue_availability_late: Your possible start date may be late for this post.
